title: ODS Document Frontmatter Schema
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema for Open Document Spec (ODS) Markdown YAML frontmatter. Enforces the 3-Tier layering model, engine constraints, and rule contracts.

$schema.description: Optional URI of the ODS document frontmatter schema for editor auto-completion and validation.

description.description: Tier 1: High-level summary of the document purpose (used in search and previews).

tags.description: Tier 1: Categorical discovery keywords and search facets.

owner.description: Tier 1: Accountable team, user, or role maintainer (e.g. 'team:docs', 'user:alice', 'role:security-lead').

created.description: Tier 1: Document creation timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601).

updated.description: Tier 1: Document last modified timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601).

odsEngine.description: Tier 2: ODS engine metadata, knowledge graph, code bindings, and context bounds.

profile.description: Profile contract defining document shape and expected headings (e.g., note, guide, feature, decision, sop, api, architecture, policy, meeting, faq, checklist, agent, skill).

status.description: Lifecycle readiness state of the document (ENUM-001).

id.description: Explicit document ID override (defaults to workspace-relative path without .md).

share.description: Visibility boundary for exports and AI context assembly (ENUM-002).

depends.description: Hard conceptual Markdown prerequisites auto-traversed in context resolution.

related.description: Soft lateral cross-references forming the discovery graph.

resources.description: Asset catalog referencing disk-level non-code files (diagrams, schemas, data).

code.description: Bidirectional bindings to source code implementations and test fixtures.

path.description: Workspace-relative or document-relative path to asset file.
Workspace-relative path to source code file. Line numbers (e.g. :L45) are forbidden (ASSET-003).

role.description: Semantic role of the bound source code artifact (ENUM-003).

symbol.description: Precise symbol identifier (function, class, struct, type, constant) in source file.

description.description: Short explanation of the code binding.

max-depth.description: Maximum recursive hops for dependency graph traversal in prompt resolution.

load.description: Auxiliary non-markdown text files to load into context budget.

ignore.description: Subtrees to exclude during recursive dependency loading.

name.description: Unique identifier name for the custom profile.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the custom profile purpose.

required_sections.description: Headings (H2/H3) that MUST appear in conforming documents.

optional_sections.description: Headings (H2/H3) that MAY appear in conforming documents.

required_keys.description: Top-level frontmatter keys that MUST appear in conforming documents.

forbidden_keys.description: Top-level frontmatter keys that MUST NOT appear in conforming documents.
